data.content:
I sent four disputes with your approval. The largest deduction, DD-48211 ($42.00), is weak because there is no order ticket on file. The next deadline is 2026-11-24, 10 days away. I saved the case notes to `/plan.md`.

**Sent**

| Case | Amount | Win chance | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| DD-48290 | $27.40 | 90% | The ticket doesn't list the claimed Protein Bowl. The order was ready at 17:35 and picked up at 17:39. |
| DD-48251 | $21.00 | 77% | The ticket lists the Chia Pudding. Pickup was 3 minutes after the order was ready. |
| DD-48267 | $16.50 | 82% | The ticket lists the Peanut Butter Bowl. Pickup was 3 minutes after the order was ready. |
| DD-48230 | $18.75 | 70% | The ticket lists the Green Smoothie. The order was ready at 13:24 and picked up at 13:29. |

- **Limits of the evidence:** For the three cases where the ticket lists the item, the ticket shows what was prepared. It doesn't prove what was packed, and the disputes say so.
- **Customer wording:** DD-48251 and DD-48267 each came from an account with 3 claims this period. I left that out of the disputes, so they say nothing about the customer.
- **Past results:** For DD-48230 and DD-48267, I used this lesson from past disputes: *doordash:missing_item [pickup_handoff+1|ticket_lists_item+1] won, "Ticket listing the item plus a prompt handoff time won."* Two of the three similar past cases won. The one loss was a side item that wasn't itemised on the ticket. DD-48267's repeat-claim count means its evidence isn't an exact match for that pattern.
- **No history for DD-48251:** It is a wrong-item claim, and I have no past cases of that type.

**Weak**
- **DD-48211 ($42.00, 35%):** There is no order ticket on file, so I couldn't check the claimed Acai Bowl (Large) against what was prepared. I didn't draft a dispute. **Please send me a photo of the ticket for order DD-48211.** With it, I can re-check the case.

**Not looked at yet**
- DD-48244 ($14.25, 60%) and DD-48280 ($9.50, 60%) were outside the top 5, so I haven't gathered evidence on them.

**Skipped**
- DD-48301 ($12.00) has a 15% win chance, so it isn't worth your time.
- DD-47990 ($0.00) is for $0.00, and its deadline passed 11 days ago.

When the platform decides these cases, tell me the results and I'll record them for future triage.
